answer.text: Option on a swap (interest rate option)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Swaption = right (not obligation) to enter an IRS at pre-specified rate. **The Trap:** Forwards obligate; swaptions don't. **Cross-Exam Context:** IV Ch 5. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Payer swaption = insurance against rising rates; receiver = insurance against falling rates.
